metric: Bounding Box Spatial Tightness & IoU Evaluation

food_waste.description: Tightly bound to actual food fragments/residue; excludes surrounding floor and clean tableware.

cable_cord.description: Tightly follows cord pathway; eliminates full-screen coverage.

water_spill.description: Bound to fluid puddle extent; segregates container from liquid spread.

broken_glass.description: Captures fragment clusters; eliminates smooth floor specular glares.

obstacle_debris.description: Bound to physical footprint of obstructions and cartons.
